title: HappEats Dry Fruits & Healthy Snacks
headline: A joyful, scalable packaging architecture for healthy snack retail.
description: HappEats committed to delivering the finest quality healthy snacks with a touch of joy. AFTER THAT engineered a complete FMCG visual identity and packaging system featuring a smile-shaped brand mark, custom wave-like leaf vector illustrations, and a color-coded SKU architecture across almonds, cashews, pistachios, raisins, and seed mixes.
challenge: Create a premium, scalable packaging system for a diverse dry fruits range that improves retail shelf visibility, communicates ingredient purity, and maintains unmistakable brand recall across both 100gm pouches and 25gm grab-and-go packs.
approach: We instituted a product-first packaging hierarchy using vibrant Pantone purple accented with distinct SKU colors (crimson for almonds, emerald for cashews, fresh green for pistachios). We paired this with custom dry fruit doodles and transparent see-through windows, accompanied by full-scale delivery vehicle fleet branding and retail cartons.
deliverables: Commercial Delivery Vehicle & Truck Fleet Branding

title: Dizzire Silks & Sarees Brand Repositioning
headline: Elegance woven into every thread — modern luxury for Kerala textile heritage.
description: Dezzire Silk and Sarees, based in Kothamangalam, Kerala, entered a new era with a refined, contemporary identity created by AFTER THAT. Rooted in the richness of Indian textile heritage, the rebranding reflects an elevated, high-fashion expression while staying true to the trust and warmth built with generations of bridal and festive customers.
challenge: Modernise a respected heritage silk and bridal saree destination with a modern, elegant visual identity that competes with national luxury fashion houses while honouring traditional handloom motifs.
approach: We created the bespoke 'D' monogram symbolizing intertwining silk threads and a central guiding star. The identity is supported by an opulent color system of imperial crimson red and woven gold, custom typography, luxury embossed carry bags, and rigorous brand usage guidelines.

title: Milli Flame Parisian Dining & Café
headline: Petite Flamme. Grand Goût. — Understated luxury in modern Parisian dining.
description: Set in Paris, Milli Flame embodies the art of understated culinary indulgence. Inspired by the belief that even the smallest flame can create remarkable depth, AFTER THAT crafted the full brand guidelines, minimal circular flame seal, Tropical Cyan & Quetzal Green visual architecture, bakery packaging, and digital touchpoints.
challenge: Establish a distinct Parisian bistro identity balancing modern culinary simplicity with quiet luxury, approachable elegance, and memorable takeaway coffee and dining collateral.
approach: We designed an organic flame silhouette nestled inside a minimalist circular badge with the French motto 'Petite Flamme. Grand Goût.'. The color system pairs fresh turquoise cyan with quetzal green and warm gold accents, supported by Nexa and Montserrat typography across menus, aprons, coffee cups, and mobile interfaces.

title: Strategic Targeting & Psychographic Ad Architecture
headline: Right Message. Right People. Real Results. — The science of purchasing decision-makers.
description: A landmark proprietary case study from AFTER THAT's agency playbook demonstrating the transformative power of audience segmentation. Shifting anti-snoring product messaging from generic user features to the actual frustrated partner resulted in a 4x surge in qualified orders and CTR.
challenge: Overcome low click-through and customer apathy caused by generic product-centric advertisements in commoditized consumer healthcare.
approach: We dissected the decision chain: the person with the condition is rarely motivated to buy; the spouse losing sleep has the urgency. By retargeting married partners ('No more sleepless nights because of his snoring'), the campaign established instant empathy and clear action.
deliverables: 5-Part Advertisement Formula (Audience, Problem, Promise, Proof, Action)
Creative Ad Split Testing (Generic vs. Strategic)
